Privacy and compatibility options for each installed app
Choose an app to configure root manager privacy, downgrades, developer options visibility and bootloader reporting. Options are independent and off by default.
Could not save the setting. Try again.
Root manager privacy
Hide supported root manager packages from this app. Root access and KernelSU module unmounting are configured separately.
Allow app downgrade

Allow an older version signed by the same developer to replace this app. You still choose and install the APK. Older versions may not understand existing app data. All Android users with this app must allow downgrades. System apps cannot go below their factory version.
Hide developer options
Report developer options and USB or wireless debugging as off through Android Settings APIs in this app. Your actual device settings stay enabled.
Bootloader spoof
Report locked bootloader properties inside this app process. This does not lock the bootloader or change hardware attestation and does not guarantee app compatibility.
After changing an option, close the app below, then reopen it. Closing may interrupt downloads or unsaved work. Restart the phone if a retained app process still uses the previous settings.
